label: 2 — Interactive Code Generation (iter-1, compile-only ablation run-3)
summary: Cold codegen of the chemical_detector study from system_description.txt + requirement_all.json. Two controllers (GasAnalysisController, MovementController), Vehicle surface, sensor/event/domain layers. 4 invented defaults, 3 design choices.

issues.title: Chem enum literals invented (Target, Other)
issues.detail: CD-DM4 defines Chem as an opaque type with equality only. Implemented as a two-literal enum; 'a reading indicates the target chemical' (CD-Fn1) is interpreted as c == Chem.Target && i > 0.0.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm the indication predicate; adjust GasSensors.analysis if a different rule is intended.

issues.title: Sensor-index to Angle mapping in location()
issues.detail: CD-Fn3 references angle(x) without defining it. Implemented 0->Left, 1->Right, 2->Back, otherwise Front (also the empty-reading safe default).

issues.title: Constant values set to 1 / 1.0
issues.detail: CD-Const1..6 specify types but no values. All set to 1 (nat) or 1.0 (real) to stay inside the configured FDR4 type ranges [0..1].
issues.fix_directive: Replace with the deployment's configured values if known.

issues.title: Initial values for state variables
issues.detail: gs=[], sts=noGas, ins=0.0, anl=Front (GA); a=Front, d0=d1=0.0, l=front, evasionTimer=0 (MV). Spec gives only 'gs initially empty'.

issues.title: No Final state: GA source-found outcome reroutes to Reading
issues.detail: CD-GA-Beh6 says the subsystem 'concludes its search' after emitting stop. A Final mode breaks the Isabelle theory generator's deadlock-freedom proof (CLAUDE.md), so GasDetected --[ins >= thr]--> Reading while still emitting stop. Likewise Found (MV) stays live via a stop-triggered self-loop (CD-MV-Beh9 'stays halted').
issues.fix_directive: Accept as the documented no-Final workaround, or request a Final state and accept the Isabelle consequence.

issues.title: CD-OP1..4 implemented as Vehicle methods, not Operation classes
issues.detail: The chain-of-thought's types:["operation"] -> compute() class rule does not fit platform operations 'provided by the Vehicle'. move/randomWalk/shortRandomWalk/changeDirection are Vehicle methods invoked from controller actions (move is a 2-arg LOperations Call; the others become events).
issues.fix_directive: None expected; flag if Operation classes were intended.

issues.title: Autonomous-only modes use total guard cover, no self-loops
issues.detail: Analysis (sts==gasD / sts==noGas), GasDetected (ins>=thr / !(ins>=thr)), AvoidingAgain (makingProgress / !makingProgress) have jointly-exhaustive guard pairs per the CLAUDE.md total-guard-cover guidance; the M2M deadlock-lint may still advise self-loops on these (known to be too broad).
issues.fix_directive: Ignore deadlock-lint advisories for these three modes unless a phase actually fails.

issues.title: Obstacle events outside Going/TryingAgain are unhandled
issues.detail: CD-MV-Beh* defines obstacle transitions only from Going and TryingAgain. Obstacle arriving in other modes is ignored (no transition).

next_step: Run the deterministic pipeline (compile -> isabelle_gen) and iterate on visible feedback only (compile-only ablation).
